drivingQuestion: How is it known that the decree was sealed for the spies' speech and not merely because their measure of sins was full?
outcomeNote: the difficulty left standing in the previous unit is answered from the wording of Numbers 14:22

segments.he: אָמַר רֵישׁ לָקִישׁ, אָמַר קְרָא: ״וַיְנַסּוּ אוֹתִי זֶה עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים״, עַל זֶה נִתְחַתֵּם גְּזַר דִּין.
segments.en: «Reish Lakish said» that «the verse states:» “All those men who have seen My glory, and My signs, which I wrought in Egypt and in the wilderness, «yet they have tried Me now [zeh] ten times» and have not listened to My voice” (Numbers 14:22). The extra word “now [zeh]” teaches that their «sentence was sealed for this» specific sin, i.e., the malicious speech of the spies.
